8 اِجْتِبَاهٌ The deeming [one] rude, coarse, unkind, hard, or churlish. (JK.) ―
-b2- And The fearing [a person or thing]. (JK.) ―
-b3- And اجتبههُ He disliked, or hated, and feared, it, or him; namely, a country, or town, and a man. (JK.) ―
-b4- He disapproved it, or disliked it, and did not find it wholesome; namely, water, (En-Nawádir, K,) &c. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
